title: Move chat completion functions to tools

sources.quoteId: nov-6-2023: 'Deprecated the Chat Completions functions parameter in favor of tools'
chat/create: functions 'Deprecated in favor of tools'; function_call 'Deprecated in favor of tool_choice'; response message.function_call 'Deprecated and replaced by tool_calls' (verified 2026-08-03)

notes.migration: functions: [{name, description, parameters}] becomes tools: [{type: 'function', function: {name, description, parameters}}]. function_call: 'auto' | 'none' | {name} becomes tool_choice: 'auto' | 'none' | {type: 'function', function: {name}}. Response side: message.function_call becomes message.tool_calls[] (array: parallel calls possible), and role:'function' result messages become role:'tool' with tool_call_id. The response-side change is why fixtures must cover the read path, not just the request payload.
notes.removalDate: None announced as of 2026-08-03 (community thread explicitly asked; no date given). Old param still functional.
edgeCases: message.function_call consumers assume a single call; tool_calls is an array: rewrite must handle iteration or assert length 1

role:'function' follow-up messages need tool_call_id threading, which requires capturing the id from the response: borderline semantic; if the rule pack can't express it, flag those call sites for human review rather than rewriting
